subject: Diwali offer: 20% off every Algotraders24 product, 5 to 14 Nov
preheader: Use code DIWALI20 at checkout. Expert Advisors and indicators, one-time purchases, 10 days only.
bodyText:
Hi,

For Diwali we are taking **20% off every product on the Algotraders24 marketplace** for 10 days.

**The offer**

- Code: **DIWALI20**
- 20% off one-time purchases of our Expert Advisors and indicators (MT4, MT5 and TradingView)
- Valid from 5 November to 14 November 2026 (Indian time)
- Pay by card or by crypto - the code works for both

**How to use it**

- Open any product page and sign in
- Type DIWALI20 in the promo code box above the Buy button and press Apply
- The new price shows right away, with the original price crossed out

Every listing page shows its evidence and its weak points, and our tools describe the market, they do not predict it. Please read the page, start on a demo account and use a small risk setting before you trade real money.

Questions? Just reply to this email - it goes straight to our support team.

The Algotraders24 team
